name: The Black Shield
summary: In Brackenwall Village, Do'gol seeks venom for a shield whose writing is hidden by burned residue. Six sacs from the marsh's Darkfang spiders hold acid that can clear its rim.

sections.title: Cleaning the Rim
sections.body: At Brackenwall Village, Do'gol studies the lettering around a shield's rim. Burned grime makes it hard to read, but acid can clear the residue. Darkfang spiders in the marsh carry venom fit for the work, so Do'gol asks you for six of their venom sacs.

sections.title: Once the Sacs Arrive
sections.body: Do'gol dislikes spiders too large to sit on and squash. After thanking you for the sacs, Do'gol tears them open and pours their venom onto the shield.

faq.q: Who asks for the spider venom?
faq.answer: Do'gol asks for spider venom in Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Why does Do'gol need venom sacs?
faq.answer: Do'gol needs acid to clear the burned residue hiding the writing on the shield's rim. Darkfang spider venom will do.

faq.q: Where do the acidic venom sacs come from?
faq.answer: The acidic venom sacs come from Darkfang spiders living in the marsh near Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: How many sacs does Do'gol want?
faq.answer: Do'gol wants six Acidic Venom Sacs.
